stem: How did Bruce Lee’s accomplishments help shape U.S. culture?

options.label: A
options.text: They caused a decline in employment in industries traditionally dominated by Asian Americans.

options.label: B
options.text: They changed the influence that Asian Americans had in the debate over civil rights.

options.label: C
options.text: They increased the political power held by Asian Americans in the government.

options.label: D
options.text: They introduced more positive depictions of Asian Americans than had historically existed.

visual_elements:
bullet list describing accomplishments of Bruce Lee:
- cultivated new and innovative areas of martial arts
- started a production company and began acting in his own movies, including Enter the Dragon
- pioneered opportunities for Asian Americans and Asian immigrants
